routes.route: Instantiate an odd-prime rank-one theorem at p=2.
routes.obstruction: The theorem interface excludes p=2 and the proof can discard powers of 2 as odd-prime units.

routes.route: Promote Gross-Zagier/Kolyvagin rank-one and finite-Sha consequences to the leading coefficient.
routes.obstruction: Rank and finiteness do not determine the exact 2-primary leading coefficient.
These invariants do not determine an exact 2-adic valuation.

routes.route: Use CM or twist-family p=2 results for the selected universal restricted class.
routes.obstruction: Family hypotheses do not match the selected quantifier.

routes.route: Use finite curve computations or WP03 formal interfaces as theorem evidence.
routes.obstruction: Their protected claim boundary is non-universal and non-theorem for BSD-R2-A1.

routes.route: Use integral quadratic plus/minus splitting via division by 2.
routes.obstruction: Division by 2 is not integral over Z_2. WP06 replaces this invalid method with exact restriction/corestriction and finite defect groups; it does not rehabilitate division by 2.

routes.route: Discard period, isogeny, interpolation, or local factors up to powers of 2.
routes.obstruction: Those powers are the quantity measured by ord_2.

routes.route: Substitute a Selmer local condition or height pairing without exact comparison.
routes.obstruction: The desired arithmetic quotient depends on the exact local condition and normalization.

routes.route: Mechanically specialize the standard odd-prime Heegner rank-lowering/primitivity proof to p=2.
routes.obstruction: The admitted sharp primitivity/index theorem is in a p>3 setup; the odd-prime rank-lowering congruence is unavailable at p=2; and Chao Li proves rank-lowering failure in a stronger surjective residual mod-2 subcase. This does not exclude a different p=2 primitivity proof.

routes.route: Use an exact p=2 Heegner-index theorem over the auxiliary field K alone to conclude the Q-side target.
routes.obstruction: WP06 shows that K-side Sha length also contains the rank-zero twist Sha length and explicit finite descent defects; analytically L'(E/K,1)=L'(E,1)L(E^D,1). These extra 2-primary terms require exact control.

reopening_condition: A terminated route may reopen only after an exact theorem discharges its named 2-primary obstruction without silently narrowing BSD-R2-A1. A different p=2 primitivity proof or a direct Q-side exact arithmetic-length theorem is a new route, not a reopening of the invalid odd-prime specialization.
